title: What Micro-Hydro Kinetic Generators Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Micro-hydro kinetic generators harvest flowing water without dams: underwater turbines in rivers and canals, and tiny turbines in pipes — turning existing flows into power with minimal environmental impact.
